column2: Flight control failure due to the launch crews forgetting to power on the gyroscope package. Missile broke up T+43 seconds. Flight considered a "partial success" because the propulsion system functioned normally until vehicle breakup.
column6: Turbopump failure followed by missile self-destruction at T+82 seconds.{{citation needed|date=February 2014}}
column7: Excessive fuel consumption by the sustainer engine led to premature cutoff. This vehicle was equipped with redesigned turbopumps following the failure of Missile 6B.{{citation needed|date=February 2014}}
column9: Placed SCORE satellite into 185 km x 1,484 km x 32.3° orbit. First use of an Atlas for a space launch. Vehicle 10B included several custom modifications for this flight.
column10: Loss of thrust at T+121 seconds due to suspected overheating in the thrust section (there was no telemetry system on this missile).
